_readme: Who co-wrote each paper and where they were, as printed on the paper (first page or affiliation list), read from the PDFs in Oct 2026. One entry per paper page in publications/. "confidence": "low" marks authors whose affiliation markers were unclear in the PDF text. "places" gives city-centre coordinates [lat, lng] for "City, Country". tools/update_collab_map.py adds new papers here automatically (from OpenAlex, marked "source": "openalex", "confidence": "auto") and tools/build_statistics.py turns this file into the collaboration map on team.html. Hand edits are kept; set "confidence" to "high" on an entry you corrected. "aliases" maps other spellings of a name, as printed on some papers, to one spelling.
